blocks.text: Adding approvers is one of the tasks for configuring Workflow Automation. Admins with access to Workflow Automation need to configure the approvers for their organization.

While investigating an incident on the Incidents page or the Incident Details page, admins can escalate the incident to an approver for their review and response. Approvers can be anyone that you choose. For example, an approver could be the manager of the end user who generated the incident. To learn more, see Managing Incidents and Viewing & Managing Incident Details.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Workflow Automation User Management > Approvers. The Approvers page appears, listing all the approvers for your organization.
On the Approvers page, click Add More. A new row appears after the last approver that is displayed.
Name: Enter the name of the approver.
Email: Enter the email address of the approver.
From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Workflow Automation User Management > Approvers. The Approvers page appears, listing all the approvers for your organization.
(Optional) On the Approvers page, use the Search field to locate the approver that you want to edit.

blocks.text: To delete an approver, click the Delete icon next to an approver.

To view approvers, from the navigation menu, go to Administration > Workflow Automation User Management > Approvers. The Approvers page appears, listing all the approvers for your organization. For approvers, you can view:

blocks.item: Name: The name of the approver.
Email: The email address of the approver.
